evidence.quote: All 343 plasma samples from the 151 patients with cirrhosis and 17 negative extraction batch controls were subjected to cfDNA extraction and 16S rRNA sequencing.
The V4 region of the bacterial 16S rRNA gene was amplified by PCR
17 negative extraction batch controls were subjected to cfDNA extraction and 16S rRNA sequencing

decontamination.tool: control-vs-sample read count exclusion; SCRuB sensitivity analysis; cross-check against published contaminant list

evidence.quote: potential contaminants were removed by excluding 243 taxa with read counts in extraction controls equal to or greater than read counts in plasma samples
ANCOM-BC2 was repeated for data with in silico decontamination by Source tracking for Contamination Removal in microBiomes (SCRuB).

notes: 343 longitudinal plasma samples from 151 patients. 256 genera after filtering (Table S2, not available); text names only differential genera (HCC, gender, Child-Pugh). Acinetobacter and Staphylococcus noted by authors as on a published contaminant list but argued to be real - not flagged. Natronomonas is archaeal.
